title: Simply Piano Practice Accuracy Leaderboard
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplypiano:session accuracy_pct=*
| stats sum(accuracy_pct) as total_value, avg(accuracy_pct) as avg_value by song_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks song name values by total and average accuracy across Simply Piano practice events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `accuracy_pct` values for each Simply Piano practice event and review total and average accuracy by song name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total accuracy.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which song name shows the biggest accuracy numbers in your Simply Piano practice data.
